original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥约州油罐车失控撞车致至少五人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥约州首府伊巴丹的Iwo Road-Ojoo高速公路上，一辆满载柴油的油罐车刹车失灵，撞上多辆汽车，造成至少五人死亡。事故发生在周六上午10时左右，地点位于Aduloju公交站附近。奥约州道路交通管理局局长向《Punch》证实了这起事故，并称事故起因是一辆载有汽车零配件的长挂车在Arilogu附近抛锚导致交通拥堵。

location.site: Aduloju Bus Stop, Iwo Road-Ojoo Expressway
location.raw_text: Iwo Road-Ojoo Expressway in Ibadan, Oyo State capital, at Aduloju Bus Stop, opposite Dominion City

key_facts.fact: 一辆柴油油罐车在伊巴丹Iwo Road-Ojoo高速公路撞上多辆汽车，造成至少五人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least five people have been killed after a diesel tanker crashed into several vehicles along the Iwo Road-Ojoo Expressway in Ibadan, the Oyo State capital.

key_facts.fact: 事故发生在周六上午10时左右，地点为Aduloju公交站附近
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The accident occurred around 10 am on Saturday at Aduloju Bus Stop, opposite Dominion City

key_facts.fact: 奥约州道路交通管理局局长Adeoye Ayoade向《Punch》证实了这起事故
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The General Manager of the Oyo State Road Traffic Management Authority, Adeoye Ayoade, confirmed the incident to Sunday PUNCH.

key_facts.fact: 事故起因是一辆载有汽车零配件的长挂车在Arilogu附近抛锚导致交通拥堵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the accident was triggered by a traffic build-up following the breakdown of a long trailer carrying motor spare parts around Arilogu at about 5 am.

uncertainties: 伤亡人数目前仅由单一来源报道，尚未获得交叉验证
事故具体原因及责任认定有待进一步核实
